instr: Balls: move the coloured balls one at a time until your pegs look exactly like the target picture.
clue: Make your pegs look exactly like the target picture. Take the top ball from a peg by clicking it (or pressing 1, 2 or 3), then click the peg where it should go. The pegs hold at most 3, 2 and 1 balls. Plan before you start and use as few moves as you can. Press Start when ready.
